title: Anemoside B4 alleviates colitis-associated colon cancer progression via Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway.
authors: Niu, Xiaoshuang; Hou, Shaowei; Yu, Yang; Liu, Chao; Yang, Yan; Luo, Yingying; Yan, Xin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物B4通过Wnt/β-catenin信号通路缓解结肠炎相关癌症，仅用分子对接预测药物与蛋白结合，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Colitis-associated cancer (CAC) is a subtype of colorectal cancer (CRC). The persistent inflammatory stimulation caused by ulcerative colitis (UC) can worsen intestinal damage and promote the development of cancer. Anemoside B4 (B4), an active component of Pulsatilla chinensis, has previously been shown to have beneficial effects against UC, which sets the stage for investigating its potential in preventing and treating CAC. Therefore, we explored the mechanism of B4 in the treatment of CAC based on RNA sequencing (RNA-seq). The results demonstrated that B4 treatment significantly improved weight loss, inhibited colon shortening, reduced both the number and size of tumors, alleviated colon tissue damage, and lowered mRNA levels of IL-1beta, IL-6, and TNF-alpha in CAC mice. RNA-seq revealed that B4 can regulate the expression of key genes in the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway, thereby interfering with the development and progression of CAC. Molecular docking predicted that B4 binds to key targets with a high affinity, specifically Wnt6, Ctnnb1, and Ccnd1. And these findings were verified by RT-qPCR and Western blot analysis. Overall, B4 can alleviate the occurrence and development of colitis associated cancer via inhibiting the activity of the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 结肠炎相关癌症（colitis-associated cancer, CAC）是结直肠癌（colorectal cancer, CRC）的一种亚型。由溃疡性结肠炎（ulcerative colitis, UC）引起的持续性炎症刺激可加重肠道损伤并促进癌症的发展。白头翁皂苷B4（Anemoside B4, B4）是白头翁（Pulsatilla chinensis）的活性成分，先前已被证明对UC具有有益作用，这为其在预防和治疗CAC中的潜力研究奠定了基础。因此，我们基于RNA测序（RNA-seq）探讨了B4治疗CAC的机制。结果表明，B4治疗显著改善了CAC小鼠的体重下降，抑制了结肠缩短，减少了肿瘤的数量和大小，减轻了结肠组织损伤，并降低了IL-1beta、IL-6和TNF-alpha的mRNA水平。RNA-seq揭示，B4能够调节Wnt/beta-catenin信号通路中关键基因的表达，从而干扰CAC的发生和发展。分子对接预测B4与关键靶点（特别是Wnt6、Ctnnb1和Ccnd1）具有高亲和力结合。这些发现通过RT-qPCR和Western blot分析得到验证。总体而言，B4通过抑制Wnt/beta-catenin信号通路的活性，能够缓解结肠炎相关癌症的发生和发展。
